## About
We're the service center for Tricolor Auto in Dallas, right on Lyndon B Johnson Fwy. We take care of car repair and maintenance, Monday through Friday during the day.
When you come in, ask for Katy in the service department. Katiria Valle is our service advisor, and reviewers mention her by name for being patient, professional and helpful when a car problem gets stressful.

## Services
- Car repair and maintenance: Repair and maintenance work for your vehicle at our Dallas service center.
